greenmoor_apple.name: Crisp Apple
greenmoor_apple.desc: From the barrel in Greenmoor's quiet corner. Sweet, and still cold.

velassas_collar.name: Velassa's Collar
velassas_collar.desc: A violet charm on a soft band. Right-click to call Velassa to your side, or to send her home. While she walks with you, your ranged attacks hit 5% harder.
